pretest_dispositions.reason: Same directional signal generator as PS-205; sizing is not an independent alpha hypothesis.

canonical_bar_and_information_rules.timestamp: UTC bar-open timestamps; DST is never applied.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.direct_series: M15 uses provider M15; H1 uses provider H1.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.derived_series: H4 and D1 are derived only from canonical H1. H4 buckets are [00,04),[04,08),[08,12),[12,16),[16,20),[20,24) UTC; D1 is [00,24) UTC.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.completeness: A derived bucket exists only when every provider-scheduled H1 bar is present. No forward fill. Provider trading-calendar metadata is versioned in the acquisition manifest.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.higher_timeframe: Only a higher-timeframe bar whose bucket end is <=the final confirmation bar close is available.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.event_notation: b is the initiating event bar; t is the final confirmation bar; e is the next tradable bar open after t.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.atr: Unless a candidate explicitly uses a completed D1 regime ATR, intraday event thresholds use ATR14 computed through the bar immediately before the referenced event bar. An event-frozen ATR_ref is not recomputed during retest confirmation.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.rolling: Rolling windows are right-exclusive of the event/current observation. Quantiles use the linear interpolation method. Same-slot histories use strictly earlier valid trading days.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.cross_market: Every peer bar must be completed by t. Missing peer data invalidates the event; forward fill and pair substitution are prohibited.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.entry_delay: The next tradable open must occur within two nominal signal-timeframe durations after t close; otherwise the event is invalid.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.primary_exit: Use the executable-side close at or before entry+12 real hours only when its staleness is <=one nominal signal-timeframe duration; otherwise the event is invalid.
canonical_bar_and_information_rules.simultaneous_signals: Within candidate+instrument+direction, overlapping 12-hour windows collapse to the earliest t; exact-t ties use H4 then H1 then M15 priority. All raw signals remain audit output.

common_outcomes.alpha_primary: Direction-adjusted executable-side return from e to the valid close at or before e+12 real hours, divided by entry-time lagged ATR14. RR-203/RR-204 use their declared portfolio-risk-unit override.
common_outcomes.matched_edge: Primary signal return minus the mean of valid prior-only matched controls, in the same unit.
breakdowns: BUY versus SELL or residual side
common_outcomes.absolute_return_gate: Positive matched edge is insufficient when raw signal return after Discovery cost stress is non-positive.
common_outcomes.subgroup_rule: Breakdowns are descriptive and can never rescue a failed pooled Base specification.

matched_control.pool: Candidate-false bars from the same predeclared instrument, timeframe and hypothetical direction.
matched_control.prior_only: Controls must be strictly earlier than the treated event, their 12-hour outcome must be resolved before t, and they must lie within the prior 90 calendar days.
matched_control.distance: Standardized Euclidean distance using median and MAD calculated only from the eligible prior control pool.
matched_control.exclusion: Control bar must not itself be a candidate signal and must not lie within the preceding 24 real hours of an earlier treated signal for the same candidate and instrument.

episode_and_inference.primary_episode_key: strategy_id + UTC calendar date + normalized hypothesis side
episode_and_inference.aggregation: Within one key, average all eligible instrument/timeframe treated-control edges; total key weight is 1.
episode_and_inference.bootstrap_unit: UTC calendar date cluster retaining every side, instrument and timeframe observed that date.
episode_and_inference.p_value: one-sided null-centered cluster bootstrap for positive effect

sample_size_and_coverage_profiles.count_first_rule: Only entry-time features, signal flags, episode IDs, data completeness, matched-control availability and group counts may be computed first. No forward return, MFE, MAE, edge or sign may be computed before this Gate.
sample_size_and_coverage_profiles.failure_action: REJECT_AS_UNDERPOWERED_WITH_P_EQUALS_1; no threshold, instrument, timeframe, period, deduplication or profile change in Phase 9.

BROAD_MULTI_ASSET_3TF.time_blocks: At least 4 of 5 fixed 12-month blocks each >=10% of episodes; no block >35%.
BROAD_MULTI_ASSET_3TF.instruments: At least two-thirds of registered instruments each >=30 episodes; no instrument >25%.
BROAD_MULTI_ASSET_3TF.timeframes: Each of M15,H1,H4 >=50 episodes and >=10%; no timeframe >70%.

BROAD_MULTI_ASSET_2TF.time_blocks: At least 4 of 5 fixed 12-month blocks each >=10% of episodes; no block >35%.
BROAD_MULTI_ASSET_2TF.instruments: At least two-thirds of registered instruments each >=30 episodes; no instrument >25%.

FX_CROSS_SECTION_H4_ONLY.time_blocks: At least 4 of 5 fixed 12-month blocks each >=25 episodes; no block >35%.
FX_CROSS_SECTION_H4_ONLY.pairs: At least 5 of 8 pairs each >=20 episodes; no pair >35%.
FX_CROSS_SECTION_H4_ONLY.currencies: AUD,EUR,GBP,JPY,USD each participate in >=20 episodes; no currency >60% of gross leg exposure.
FX_CROSS_SECTION_H4_ONLY.synchronization: All eight pair inputs available for >=95% of predeclared eligible timestamps; no forward fill.

FX_NETWORK_2TF.time_blocks: At least 4 of 5 fixed 12-month blocks each >=25 episodes; no block >35%.
FX_NETWORK_2TF.pairs: At least 5 of 8 pairs each >=20 episodes; no pair >35%.
FX_NETWORK_2TF.currencies: AUD,EUR,GBP,JPY,USD each participate in >=20 episodes; no currency >60% of gross leg exposure.
FX_NETWORK_2TF.synchronization: All eight pair inputs available for >=95% of predeclared eligible timestamps; no forward fill.
FX_NETWORK_2TF.timeframes: H1 and H4 each >=50 episodes and >=20%.

TWO_LEG_PAIR_H4_ONLY.time_blocks: At least 4 of 5 fixed 12-month blocks each >=25 episodes; no block >35%.
TWO_LEG_PAIR_H4_ONLY.residual_sides: Positive and negative residual sides each >=75 episodes and >=25%.
TWO_LEG_PAIR_H4_ONLY.execution: Both synchronized legs and per-leg costs required for every episode.

RISK_OVERLAY_H4_ONLY.source: Exact H4 timestamps and directions from PS-205; managed and unit-notional returns must be paired.
RISK_OVERLAY_H4_ONLY.instruments: At least two-thirds of registered PS-205 instruments each >=30 paired episodes; no instrument >25%.

discovery_cost_model.executable_prices: BUY enters ASK open and exits BID close; SELL enters BID open and exits ASK close. Two-leg studies apply this independently to both legs.
discovery_cost_model.base: Observed point-in-time BID/ASK spread is embedded through executable sides.
discovery_cost_model.preregistered_stress: Additionally subtract 0.25*(entry spread + exit spread) per filled leg as slippage stress.
discovery_cost_model.commission_financing: Include point-in-time provider commission/financing when available. Missing broker-specific historical cost does not permit EA promotion and must be revalidated with OANDA before OOS/final promotion.
discovery_cost_model.two_leg: Gross-normalized weights; cost, slippage and financing apply per leg.
discovery_cost_model.failure: Raw signal mean after preregistered stress <=0 is REJECT_FOR_DEVELOPMENT even if matched edge is positive.

sensitivity_policy.oat_variants: Three registered parameters, loose/base/strict one-at-a-time: Base plus six variants.
sensitivity_policy.same_positive_sign_required: At least 5 of 7 including Base; underpowered variant is not positive.
sensitivity_policy.use: May reject for instability only; may not promote, retune, rank, split or rescue.

discovery_decision.DEVELOPMENT: Pass count/coverage Gate AND primary effect >=0.05 standardized units AND 95% CI lower>0 AND BH adjusted p<=0.10 AND stressed raw mean>0 AND applicable breadth signs AND sensitivity positive-sign count>=5 of 7.

BREADTH_SIGNS.broad: At least two-thirds of count-eligible instruments positive; 3TF requires >=2/3 timeframes positive; 2TF requires both positive; >=60% of count-eligible time blocks positive; applicable asset classes: >=2/3 or both when only two.
BREADTH_SIGNS.fx: At least two-thirds of count-eligible pairs positive; RR-202 requires both timeframes positive; >=60% time blocks positive.
BREADTH_SIGNS.two_leg: Both residual sides positive and >=60% time blocks positive.
BREADTH_SIGNS.overlay: At least two-thirds of count-eligible instruments have positive paired Delta Sharpe and >=60% time blocks positive.

discovery_decision.WATCH: Reserved only for result-unseen operational or data-status holds. Statistical near misses are not WATCH.
discovery_decision.REJECT_FOR_DEVELOPMENT: Any tested confirmatory question failing one or more DEVELOPMENT Gates.
discovery_decision.REJECT_AS_UNDERPOWERED: Count/coverage failure before any return calculation.
discovery_decision.DATA_INSUFFICIENT: Required frozen data fields unavailable; no return calculation and no same-Phase replacement.

risk_overlay_studies.name: Volatility-Managed PS-205 Risk Overlay
risk_overlay_studies.source_signals: Exact H4 timestamps and directions generated by Base STRAT-P9-PS-205. No separate entry eligibility or direction.
risk_overlay_studies.position_multiplier: min(1.50,max(0.25,0.10/RV20_annualized_at_t)); RV20 uses completed H4 returns through t and the provider trading-calendar annualization factor.
risk_overlay_studies.comparator: Unit-notional position at identical timestamps and directions.
risk_overlay_studies.primary: Delta episode Sharpe = nonannualized mean/stdev of stressed managed 12h returns minus the same statistic for stressed unit-notional returns.

candidates.name: Failed 20-Bar Break Reversal
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis; not a post-hoc sign flip of PA-101/PA-105
candidates.hypothesis: A decisive new 20-bar extreme that is reclaimed within two bars traps late breakout participation and mean-reverts.
entry_conditions: Break bar b closes >=0.15*ATR14(b) beyond the prior 20-bar high, or <=-0.15*ATR below the prior low, with close-location>=0.75 in the break direction.
By t<=b+2, price closes at least 0.10*ATR14(t) back inside the pre-break 20-bar boundary.
The reclaim bar body/range>=0.40 and close-location>=0.60 in the reversal direction.
Enter opposite the failed break at the next bar open.
entry_time_information: completed OHLC through reclaim bar t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on breakout-distance quartile; controls are unreclaimed breakouts
weaknesses: reclaim may be a normal retest before continuation
large spread around news can mimic a failure

candidates.name: Higher-Timeframe Trend Pullback Re-acceleration
candidates.lineage: new ID; structural redesign of PA-103
candidates.hypothesis: A lower-timeframe pullback resumes only when a completed higher timeframe shows a persistent trend and the lower timeframe prints structural re-acceleration.
entry_conditions: Regime map is fixed: M15 uses completed H4; H1 and H4 use completed D1.
BUY regime: EMA20>EMA60 and EMA20(t)-EMA20(t-5)>=0.25*ATR14 on the regime timeframe; SELL symmetric.
On the signal timeframe, the last 2..6 bars retrace 0.50..1.75*ATR14 against the regime and touch EMA20, but no bar closes beyond EMA50 against the regime.
BUY confirmation at t closes above max(H[t-2:t-1]) with body/range>=0.50; SELL symmetric.
Enter with the higher-timeframe regime at the next bar open.
entry_time_information: signal-timeframe OHLC and EMA through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on higher-timeframe EMA20-EMA60 gap quartile and pullback-depth quartile
weaknesses: EMA trend is delayed
H4 signals depend on daily close convention
cross-timeframe synchronization must be audited

candidates.name: European Session Range False-Break
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis; PA-105 continuation remains retired
candidates.hypothesis: A false break of a fixed pre-European range that rapidly returns inside the range is a rejection event, distinct from an ordinary session breakout.
entry_conditions: Define the range once per UTC day from bars with open times 00:00<=time<06:00; eligible break bars open 06:00<=time<10:00.
The pre-session range must be 0.75..2.50*the ATR14 measured at 06:00.
Break bar b trades and closes >=0.15*ATR beyond the range high, or <=-0.15*ATR below the range low.
By t<=b+2, a completed bar closes >=0.10*ATR back inside the range with close-location>=0.65 in the reversal direction.
Only the first false break per UTC day and side is eligible; enter opposite the break next bar open.
candidates.matched_control: same instrument, timeframe, year, calendar month, direction, and pre-session-range/ATR quartile; unreclaimed breaks are excluded from controls
weaknesses: UTC does not follow daylight-saving changes
energy instruments are intentionally excluded
news releases can dominate session effects

candidates.name: Long-Horizon Trend with Intraday Pullback
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis grounded in long-horizon time-series momentum
candidates.hypothesis: D1 trends measured over weeks, rather than hours, persist and can be entered after a bounded H1/H4 countertrend pullback.
entry_conditions: Using the last completed D1 bar, signed 20-day and 60-day close returns have the same sign.
abs(60-day close return)/D1_ATR20 >=2.50 and the 60-day direction defines BUY or SELL.
On H1/H4, the prior 2..6 bars retrace 0.50..1.50*signal-timeframe ATR14 against the D1 direction.
At t, price closes beyond the prior 3-bar extreme in the D1 direction with body/range>=0.50.
Enter next bar open in the D1 direction.
entry_time_information: last completed D1 OHLC through prior day
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on D1 60-day return/ATR decile; controls lack the bounded pullback-and-resumption pattern
weaknesses: slow trend reversals
roll/financing effects are absent from spot OHLC
H1 and H4 events can overlap

candidates.name: Seasonally Adjusted Participation Shock
candidates.lineage: new ID; measurement redesign of VV-101
candidates.hypothesis: A directional expansion continues only when participation is exceptional relative to the same instrument and UTC bar slot, spread is normal, and the next bar confirms rather than fully retraces it.
entry_conditions: SeasonalVolumeRatio[t]=tick_volume[t]/median of the previous 40 trading-day observations with the same instrument, timeframe, and UTC bar-start slot.
Shock bar b has SeasonalVolumeRatio>=1.75, range>=1.50*ATR14, body/range>=0.60, and close-location>=0.75 in its direction.
Observed spread at b is <=the trailing 252-slot 80th percentile; missing spread invalidates the event.
Confirmation bar t=b+1 closes in the shock direction beyond the shock midpoint and does not close beyond the opposite 50% of the shock range.
Enter in the shock direction next bar open.
entry_time_information: completed tick volume and OHLC through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on raw tick-volume decile; treatment is distinguished by seasonal residual and confirmation
weaknesses: tick volume is not signed order flow
40-day same-slot warm-up is large
historical spread may be unavailable in discovery source

candidates.name: Compressed Balance Release Retest
candidates.lineage: Pretest merger of draft PS-201 and draft LV-202; structural redesign informed by PA-101/PA-102/VV-102 failures. Predecessors remain retired; no Phase 8 subgroup outcome selected this specification.
candidates.hypothesis: A volatility-compressed 20-bar balance break persists only when the broken boundary survives a prompt retest and price reconfirms in the break direction.
entry_conditions: Let b be the first eligible break bar after no active setup. Define ATR_ref=ATR14 on the signal timeframe through b-1.
The median true range of bars b-12..b-1 is <=the linear-method 20th percentile of the 240 true ranges b-252..b-13.
Define the pre-break boundary from exactly bars b-20..b-1. BUY: C[b]>=max(H[b-20:b-1])+0.10*ATR_ref; SELL symmetric. Break-bar range>=1.25*ATR_ref and body/range>=0.55.
Within b+1..b+3, the first bar whose low for BUY or high for SELL reaches within 0.20*ATR_ref of the boundary starts the retest; no completed close may penetrate >0.20*ATR_ref inside the boundary.
The first touched retest bar, or a later bar within b+1..b+3, that closes beyond the boundary with close-location>=0.65 in the break direction is confirmation t.
Enter next tradable bar open after t. Ignore later break bars while this setup or its 12-hour outcome window is active.
entry_time_information: completed OHLC and true range through t
lagged 240-bar volatility distribution ending at b-13
candidates.matched_control: Common prior-only control plus pre-break median-TR percentile and 20-bar boundary-distance quartiles; controls are eligible releases without a successful retest confirmation.
weaknesses: compound confirmation may be underpowered
confirmation can erase reward-to-risk
percentiles can shift across regimes

diagnostic_only.prior_8bar_range_over_atr: Recorded from draft PS-201 but never used for entry, ranking, promotion, subgroup rescue, or threshold revision.

candidates.name: Confirmed Climactic Absorption
candidates.lineage: new ID; confirmation redesign of VV-103
candidates.hypothesis: An extreme, high-participation terminal wick reverses only when the following bar recovers the extreme bar midpoint without making a meaningful new extreme.
entry_conditions: Prior three-bar move into b is >=1.00*ATR14 in the exhausted direction.
Bar b range>=2.50*ATR14, SeasonalVolumeRatio>=1.50, and terminal wick/range>=0.40 on the exhausted side.
Confirmation t=b+1 does not extend the exhausted extreme by more than 0.10*ATR14 and closes through b midpoint in the reversal direction.
Confirmation body/range>=0.40; enter in the reversal direction next bar open.
entry_time_information: completed OHLC and seasonally normalized tick volume through t
candidates.matched_control: common control plus exact match on b range/ATR and SeasonalVolumeRatio deciles; controls are climax bars lacking midpoint recovery
weaknesses: rare on H4
extreme bars have high slippage
one-bar confirmation may still be too short

candidates.name: Cross-Sectional FX Momentum Rank
candidates.lineage: independent new hypothesis informed by currency momentum research
candidates.hypothesis: The relative ranking of currency strength over weeks is more informative than same-direction USD or JPY breadth over hours.
entry_conditions: At each completed D1 close, estimate AUD/EUR/GBP/JPY/USD strength scores by least squares from all eight oriented pair log returns over 20 and 60 D1 bars, with currency scores constrained to sum to zero.
For each tradable pair, the base-minus-quote score gap must have the same sign at 20 and 60 days and rank in the top absolute quartile among the eight pairs.
The pair was in the top absolute quartile on at least 3 of the previous 5 completed D1 dates.
On H4, a 2..6-bar pullback of 0.50..1.50 ATR is followed by a close beyond the prior 3-bar extreme in the score-gap direction; enter next H4 open.
If multiple pairs qualify at the same t, trade only the pair with the largest absolute 60-day score gap.
entry_time_information: completed D1 prices for all eight FX pairs
no future ranking or pair substitution
candidates.matched_control: same date and H4 trigger among pairs in the middle two score-gap quartiles, matched on absolute 60-day return and volatility
weaknesses: small eight-pair cross-section
currency scores depend on network coverage
portfolio concentration may repeatedly select JPY pairs

candidates.name: Currency-Basket Residual Reversion
candidates.lineage: independent new relative-value hypothesis; MR-101/MR-102 continuation remain retired
candidates.hypothesis: A single FX pair that moves far beyond the move implied by its two currencies and the remaining pair network tends to close part of the residual gap.
entry_conditions: For each target pair and bar t, estimate base and quote currency 12-bar returns from the other seven pairs only; the target pair is excluded from its own basket fit.
Residual=target 12-bar log return minus the leave-one-pair-out implied return. Standardize using the previous 240 target-timeframe residuals.
At bar b, abs(residual_z)>=2.00 while the median absolute standardized return of the seven peer pairs is <=1.00.
By t<=b+2, residual z moves toward zero by >=0.25 and the target closes in the reversion direction; enter next bar open toward zero.
entry_time_information: same-timestamp completed bars for all eight FX pairs
leave-one-out rolling residual history ending before b
candidates.matched_control: same pair, timeframe, year, UTC bucket, direction, and residual-z band 1.00..1.50; controls are not extreme
weaknesses: synchronous data gaps invalidate events
currency network may be underidentified during missing bars
residual can reflect genuine pair-specific news

candidates.name: Gold-Silver Dynamic Hedge Residual
candidates.lineage: independent pair-residual hypothesis replacing MR-103 co-momentum
candidates.hypothesis: A temporary deviation in the dynamically hedged gold-silver residual mean-reverts when the prior formation window shows stable positive comovement and finite half-life.
entry_conditions: Using the last 120 completed D1 observations, regress log(XAU) on log(XAG) with intercept; require beta>0 and R-squared>=0.60.
Fit AR(1) to lagged residuals using only the same formation window; require 0.10<rho<0.95 and implied half-life between 2 and 30 D1 bars.
Standardize the current completed H4 residual using the prior 120 D1 residual mean and standard deviation; at b abs(z)>=2.00.
At t=b+1, z moves toward zero by >=0.25 without exceeding abs(z)=3.50; enter a beta-hedged two-leg position toward zero next H4 open.
entry_time_information: completed synchronous H4 prices through t
rolling beta, residual, rho, and z known at t
candidates.matched_control: same pair formation state and z direction with 1.00<=abs(z)<=1.50, matched on beta, R-squared, half-life, and volatility
weaknesses: cointegration can break
two-leg costs and margin are material
spot/CFD closing times must be synchronized

primary_outcome_override.weights: For positive residual: w_A=-1/(1+abs(beta)), w_B=+beta/(1+abs(beta)); reverse both for negative residual. Gross absolute notional=1 and entry-time beta is held for 12 hours.
primary_outcome_override.execution: Each leg uses its executable BID/ASK entry and exit side; costs and slippage stress are applied per leg.
primary_outcome_override.risk_unit: Standard deviation of 12-real-hour hedged portfolio returns calculated from the 120 completed H4 observations strictly before entry using the same entry-time beta.
primary_outcome_override.primary: cost-adjusted 12-hour two-leg P&L divided by the lagged portfolio risk unit

candidates.name: Brent-WTI Dynamic Hedge Residual
candidates.lineage: new ID; structural redesign of MR-104
candidates.hypothesis: A dynamically hedged Brent-WTI residual with stable recent mean reversion is superior to a raw 24-hour performance-gap reversal.
entry_conditions: Using the last 120 completed D1 observations, regress log(Brent) on log(WTI) with intercept; require beta>0 and R-squared>=0.70.
Fit AR(1) to formation residuals; require 0.10<rho<0.95 and implied half-life between 2 and 30 D1 bars.
At completed H4 bar b, abs(residual_z)>=2.00 using only the lagged formation mean and standard deviation.
At t=b+1, z moves toward zero by >=0.25 and remains abs(z)<3.50; enter beta-hedged two-leg reversion next H4 open.
entry_time_information: completed D1 Brent and WTI formation data
contract/CFD roll metadata available at t
candidates.matched_control: same beta/R-squared/half-life state and z direction with 1.00<=abs(z)<=1.50, excluding roll-distorted bars
weaknesses: roll and CFD financing can dominate
structural oil-market shocks break the spread
two-leg execution requires synchronized quotes

primary_outcome_override.weights: For positive residual: w_A=-1/(1+abs(beta)), w_B=+beta/(1+abs(beta)); reverse both for negative residual. Gross absolute notional=1 and entry-time beta is held for 12 hours.
primary_outcome_override.execution: Each leg uses its executable BID/ASK entry and exit side; costs and slippage stress are applied per leg.
primary_outcome_override.risk_unit: Standard deviation of 12-real-hour hedged portfolio returns calculated from the 120 completed H4 observations strictly before entry using the same entry-time beta.
primary_outcome_override.primary: cost-adjusted 12-hour two-leg P&L divided by the lagged portfolio risk unit
